# unguarded_reason: Factory (http.param fed only from IHttpClientFactory) | Upstream:<path> (http.param supplied only by <path>; http.register in a project that cannot reach Ashlar.Infrastructure, composed by the executable <path>) | Governance (the MEAI pairs F5 holds) | Exempt:<LocalOnly|Operator|Inbound|DataStore|LocalDaemon|ConsumerSdk|TestDouble|TestSeam> (ConsumerSdk only under src/Ashlar.Client/) | Exempt:GuardImpl (src/Ashlar.Abstractions/Security/Egress/ only) | -. Exempt reasons are final.
# ids: EG-... rows of docs/EgressInventory.md, comma-separated, or -. F1, F2 and F3 print the observed rows in this form when they fail.
